description: Add an anime series to the signed-in person's MyAnimeTracker list with a status. A series is tracked as one thing: all its seasons and films. If any part of it is already on the list, nothing changes. Give a title or a catalog ID.

mal_id.description: The catalog ID from a title search (the same number MyAnimeList uses). Use it instead of a title when you have it.

status.description: Where to put it: plan_to_watch (the default), watching, completed, on_hold or dropped.

title.description: The show's name, in English or romaji, for example "Frieren".

name: add_to_list
title: Add to my list
